evals.prompt: Our Lighthouse accessibility score is 100. Can we say the site is WCAG AA compliant?
evals.expected_output: Explains automated tools catch only part of WCAG issues, lists the manual checks still needed (keyboard, focus, screen reader, zoom, dynamic content), and avoids declaring compliance.
expectations: States that automated scores don't establish WCAG compliance
Lists manual checks such as keyboard and screen reader testing

evals.prompt: Check this icon-only button:
evals.expected_output: Flags the div as not keyboard accessible and unnamed, and replaces it with a native button with an accessible name.
expectations: Identifies missing keyboard access and accessible name
Replaces it with a native button element
Adds an aria-label or visually hidden text

evals.prompt: Our brand gray #999999 on white for body text — fine?
evals.expected_output: Computes the contrast ratio (about 2.8:1), says it fails WCAG AA for body text (4.5:1), and suggests a darker gray that passes with its ratio.
expectations: Suggests a passing alternative color with its ratio
